name: bj-outdoor-trip
description: 北野行 · 北京周边短途游微信小程序（第一阶段）

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --prefix server && npm run test --prefix web
